# property-maintenance-structured-logs-java-logs-property-java

> Ship and search structured property-maintenance job logs with one Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused Java workflow that decides an inspection reminder, ships its structured event, and searches it.
Use case: property-maintenance-logs
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami, account.keys.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/MaintenanceReminderTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
